title: llama-index-experimental is no longer maintained
summary: The maintainer states that llama-index-experimental is deprecated, no longer maintained, and will receive no further updates or bug fixes.

constraints: Preserve data connectors, indexes, query behavior, prompts, model configuration, serialization, and observability used by the application.

steps.title: Replace experimental integrations
steps.instructions: Inventory the experimental APIs in use, select maintained LlamaIndex or alternative implementations for each, migrate call sites, then remove the package.

verification.purpose: Run indexing, retrieval, generation, persistence, and project tests when defined.
